title: Four questions every calibration session raises

questions.question: Is pacing the same as mirroring?
questions.answer: No. Pacing is tempo; mirroring is posture and gesture. Both build baseline, but they are independent channels.

questions.question: How do I know the frame has set?
questions.answer: The subject corrects you unprompted and then expands — that is the strongest single marker.

questions.question: What breaks calibration fastest?
questions.answer: Rushing the lead. If the mismatch is too large, the other system flags it as anomaly and the loop resets.

questions.question: Does this work in writing?
questions.answer: Partially. Without body channels you lose posture; pacing survives in sentence rhythm and message cadence.
